q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: WITH beer_prices AS (SELECT s.beer, s.price FROM serves AS s JOIN frequents AS f ON s.bar = f.bar JOIN drinker AS d ON f.drinker = d.name WHERE d.name LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer, s.price HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2), beer_stats AS (SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM beer_prices GROUP BY beer) SELECT beer, price_gap, avg_price FROM beer_stats ORDER BY beer
